purpose: Visible modeled mutual airflow and a bounded post-hoc numerical diagnosis; no fresh mission success claim

diagnostic.reason: Narrow-case historical trajectory difference first exceeds 1 cm at 30 s. Restart both step sizes from identical full state at 20 s to separate local error growth from inherited differences. This is post-hoc development evidence.
diagnostic.motorReplay: Fine replay runs use precisely the coarse closed-loop four motor targets per drone, held every 10 ms; no new feedback decisions. Not a feasible autonomous policy or safety evaluation.
diagnostic.comparison: Same-ID Euclidean position errors every 0.1 s; all outcomes retained; original milestone31 1cm failures stay failed. No new acceptance threshold or statistical generalization.
diagnostic.safety: Same swept contacts and vehicle floor checks; stop on contact; compare common time interval only.

visualization.historicalTrials: milestone28 seed1601 count50 wide: off, sum-force, sum-rotor, rss-rotor
visualization.field: Recompute corrected milestone28 field only at exact saved poses; snapshot reconstruction, NOT actual historical sample-and-held loads. Never reconstruct from interpolated poses and call it measured.
visualization.plumes: Far-wake half-width contour, world metres. Source axis and shape from same normalized kernel; arrows/particles decorative direction cues, not fluid trajectories; no resolved wall interaction.
visualization.twoDrone: Static hover poses; four-rotor mean axial inflow; constant ideal induced-power thrust-loss hypothesis; unsupported geometry shown as outside domain.
